home.painTitle: The hard parts of planning Uzbekistan, solved
home.painText: We asked what makes tourists give up or overpay. Each answer below is a working feature of this website, not a promise.

pains.a: The AI trip planner builds a day-by-day route from our real tours, with realistic train and road times between cities.
Every tour shows an indicative price for your group size and date, in dollars, so‘m or euros, before you contact anyone.
The site and the assistant work in English, Uzbek and Russian. Ask in your language and the answer comes back in it.

pains.q: “I don’t want to prepay a stranger”
pains.a: Booking is a free request. Nothing is paid online and nothing is binding until our team confirms availability and the final price.
The travel guide and the assistant answer practical questions at any hour, and say clearly what you should double-check officially.
The assistant only uses our own tour catalogue and links every tour it mentions. If it is ever unavailable, you can still search tours and reach our team directly.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: What information we collect when you use this website, why we need it and how you can control it.
privacy.body:
## Who we are
This website is run by [[agency]], a travel company based in Uzbekistan. For any question about your data, write to us using the details on the [contact page](/contact).

## What we collect
- **Booking and request details** you send through our forms: your name, email, phone number, preferred messenger, travel dates, group size and any notes you add.
- **Messages to our travel assistant and AI planner.** We store conversations so that we can answer follow-up questions and improve the service. Please do not share passport numbers, card details or other sensitive information in the chat.
- **Newsletter email**, if you subscribe.
- **Technical data** needed to run the site safely: a shortened, non-reversible fingerprint of your IP address used to stop spam and abuse, and basic server logs.

## How we use it
- To answer your request, prepare your programme and manage your booking.
- To contact you on the channel you chose.
- To send the newsletter you subscribed to. Every email has an unsubscribe option.
- To protect the website from spam and misuse.

We do not sell your personal data and we do not use advertising trackers.

## AI assistant
Questions you type into the assistant or the planner are sent to an AI service to generate the answer. We send only the conversation itself, together with information about our tours and destinations. We do not send your booking details, passwords or payment information. AI answers are a starting point; our team confirms prices and availability.

## Cookies and local storage
We use a small number of strictly necessary cookies: your language and currency choice, and a secure sign-in cookie for staff. Tours you save to your wishlist are kept only in your own browser. Maps are loaded from OpenStreetMap when you open them.

## How long we keep data
Booking and request records are kept for as long as needed to provide the service and meet accounting obligations. Assistant conversations are deleted automatically after a retention period set by our team (90 days by default).

## Your rights
You can ask us to show, correct or delete the personal data we hold about you, or to stop sending you emails. Write to us and we will reply within a reasonable time.

terms.title: Booking terms
terms.lead: How requests, confirmations, prices and changes work when you book with us.
terms.body:
## Requests and confirmation
Sending a booking form, a tour builder route or a service request is free and does not oblige you to anything. It becomes a confirmed booking only after our team confirms availability and the final price to you in writing (by email or messenger) and you accept it.

## Prices
- Prices on the website are per person unless stated otherwise and depend on the group size and the dates.
- Prices shown in currencies other than the tour's own currency are converted at the current rate and may change slightly.
- Estimates from the tour builder and the AI planner are indicative only. The binding price is the one in your written confirmation.

## Payment
The payment amount, method and deadline are stated in your confirmation. We never ask for card details on this website or in the chat.

## Changes and cancellations
Cancellation and change conditions depend on the tour, the season and the services booked (hotels, trains, flights). They are listed in your confirmation before you pay. If we have to change a programme because of circumstances outside our control, we offer an equivalent alternative or a refund for the services not provided.

## Travel documents and health
Travellers are responsible for valid passports, visas and any required registrations; we are happy to help with information and invitation letters where possible. We strongly recommend travel insurance that covers medical costs and cancellation. Please tell us in advance about any health conditions, dietary needs or mobility limitations.

## During the trip
Please follow the instructions of your guide and driver, respect local customs at religious sites, and take care of your personal belongings. Times in the programme are approximate and may shift because of traffic, weather or opening hours.

## Reviews
Reviews are published only after moderation. We do not change the meaning of a review.

## Contact
Questions about these terms? Contact [[agency]] using the details on the [contact page](/contact).
